claim: Fiber v0.9.0 external-funding collaboration has two upstream quirks this repo works around: (1) build_base_from_funding_cell inserts the funder's UDT change output at index 1 (before preserved peer outputs), so the acceptor's UDT input cell must exactly equal the channel amount or VerifyFundingTx fails with InvalidPeerFundingTx; (2) the funding fee is sized against a single 85-byte placeholder witness while the final tx carries two witness groups, so funding_fee_rate must be raised (we use 2000/KW) or the broadcast is rejected as LowFeeRate.
why: These constraints explain the exact-amount operator UDT cells (ops/data/prep-operator-cells.mjs), the funding_fee_rate=0x7d0 in useSwap.ts open params, and why a failed run locks operator cells in the live-cells exclusion map until the funding tx commits or fnn restarts.
